doctrine.summary: Journey tokens describe identity, capability ownership, routing, safety and optional surface customization.
doctrine.identity_note: Journey is the orchestration system. Domain profiles may rename or decorate capabilities without replacing Journey's identity.
doctrine.empty_folder_policy: Never delete a folder solely because it is empty.
doctrine.routing_policy: Files live in their natural canonical home first; specificity is added through representations such as shortcuts, manifests, tags and project views.
doctrine.token_reception_policy: Every incoming item carries an existing token or receives a provisional token at reception. Routing follows verified identity evidence.
doctrine.ambient_congruence_policy: Always observe within granted scope; auto-apply only safe, reversible, high-confidence and low-cost maintenance; ask for ambiguity, judgment, destructive action, unclear ownership or expensive work.
doctrine.resource_doctrine: Foreground responsiveness wins; heavy compute makes stewardship throttle or pause; idle periods permit deeper maintenance.
doctrine.mutation_policy: Detect and propose first; execute only through approved, reversible operations.
doctrine.prompt_policy: Prompts are for real judgment, not routine housekeeping.
do_not_auto_apply_policy: changes with unclear ownership or destination

visual_identity.policy: Expression profiles may provide presentation assets; those assets remain owned by their source projects.

representations.boundary: Project-specific doctrine and assets remain in the owning project.
